title: Pinned open-source method references and optional research runtime
verification: Primary upstream repository contents/licenses; tag commits resolved through GitHub API. Git blob identifiers are SHA-1, not SHA-256.

source_use_policy.methods: Independently implement the declared mathematical ideas; do not copy or translate upstream code.
source_use_policy.optional_dependencies: Installed separately through their public Python interfaces; retain their original notices and record actual distributions/wheel hashes in each experiment.
source_use_policy.copyleft: TUM/OpenLAP are method references only. CasADi is an optional external LGPL library. MIT does not relicense upstream software or data.
source_use_policy.claim_limit: No upstream accuracy, optimality or real-vehicle energy result is transferred to this model.

sources.method: Separate track geometry, tire capability and dynamics; independently diagnose axle load/force feasibility.
sources.limit: No copied solver/model; no validated real F1 axle parameters.

sources.method: Audit smooth closed geometry, true arc length, route boundaries and energy-loss accounting independently.
sources.limit: No source/data copied; historical route is not the measured 2026 racing line.

sources.method: Falsify model hypotheses from residual shapes; keep formal RMSE and diagnostic robust summaries distinct.
sources.limit: Residual shape alone does not identify a unique physical cause.

sources.license: MIT with additional file-specific third-party notices
sources.method: Make SAC sampling, termination, Q targets, entropy and update accounting explicit and auditable.
sources.limit: No copied SAC file; pinned LICENSE has additional SAC provenance notices.

sources.method: Separate learner proposal, environment execution and independently checked constraint certificate.
sources.limit: This public-rule subset is not a complete FIA ECU safety certificate.

sources.method: Differential-check sampled SAC equations, automatic differentiation, optimizers and target updates against an explicit protocol.
sources.limit: Reference commit differs from release tag; a custom SB3-aligned learner is not stock SB3 training.

sources.method: Generate bounded fixed-mode surrogate action proposals; certify them with the exact causal executor.
sources.limit: Reference commit differs from release tag; surrogate feasibility/optimality does not certify the piecewise FSM execution.

sources.method: Independently compare forward acceleration/backward braking feasibility and point-mass tire budgets.
sources.limit: No MATLAB source/data translated or copied; no sector-specific grip tuning.

sources.method: Float64 automatic differentiation and optimizer comparison.
sources.limit: Record actual wheel/platform; numerical agreement is scoped to tested batches and tolerances.

sources.method: Explicit terminated/truncated interface with unchanged raw action and physical-step information.
sources.limit: A wrapper must preserve physical terminal failures and prevent time-limit bootstrap from treating them as continuing states.
